Note=Cycles between the cytosol and the peroxisome matrix (PubMed:11336669, PubMed:16314507). Following binding to cargo proteins containing a PTS1 peroxisomal targeting signal in the cytosol, recruited to the docking complex, composed of PEX13 and PEX14, leading to translocation into the peroxisome matrix along with cargo proteins (By similarity). Cys-11 of PEX5 is then monoubiquitinated, promoting its extraction from peroxisomal membrane by the PEX1-PEX6 AAA ATPase complex (PubMed:16314507, PubMed:19208625, PubMed:24118911, PubMed:29884772). Extraction is accompanied by unfolding of the TPR repeats and release of bound cargo in the peroxisome matrix (By similarity). The TPR repeats refold in the cytosol and ubiquitination is removed by deubiquitinating enzymes, resetting PEX5 for a subsequent import cycle (By similarity). {ECO:0000250|UniProtKB:A0A1L8FDW4, ECO:0000269|PubMed:11336669, ECO:0000269|PubMed:16314507, ECO:0000269|PubMed:19208625, ECO:0000269|PubMed:24118911, ECO:0000269|PubMed:29884772}.
